main_text.p: vimus: Fugæ Vacui & Impedimenta Vacui, Appetitiones naturales & Aversationes naturales, Sympathiæ & Antipathiæ, Formæ substantiales & Intelligentiæ, Facultates & Potentiæ, funt, inquam, illa omnia Pantomimi propria, mancipio & nexu, usu & fructu: Quibus adde manubias & prædas, quas, agrum Rationis, contra jus & fas depopulatus, asportavit. page.notes: Right edge carries show-through from the facing page and fragmentary marginal text of the adjacent page, not transcribed. Italic words are transcribed as <i>. Possible printing error: "Pantomimi propria" as printed; "Pantomimus" and "Pantomimi" left as printed.
